rules.identity: Stable resource IDs do not change when translated. Source records and canonical resources have separate IDs. Name similarity is a candidate relationship, not identity or nutritional equivalence. Cooking/prepared state, cultivar, variety and product formulation remain explicit.
rules.citations: Every assertion, relationship, ingredient mention, source quantity, cultural representation and translation cites its original source record/revision. Derived facts cite all input assertions and the derivation method. Dataset wrappers cannot replace original source citations.
rules.values: All values have a declared datatype. Display text is localized text with source language, source text hash and translation provenance. IDs, numbers, dates, units, currencies and relationship predicates are never translated into stored identities. Unknown remains null with a qualifier; ranges and limits are preserved.
rules.quantity: Magnitude, dimension, unit, count entity, denominator/basis, preparation state, source notation and measurement method are separate. Only exact supported unit conversions are allowed. Cups/spoons/servings/historical measures require their own definitions; no density or yield is inferred.
rules.recipes: Common recipe concepts join identified source variants. A WorkedRecipe is a distinct editorial resource citing variants and ingredient/quantity decisions. Contradictory methods or ingredient alternatives are retained; quantities are not blindly averaged. Unreviewed/OCR variants cannot be planning-qualified by a join.
rules.culture: CulturalRepresentation connects a dish, local names, ingredients/substitutions, preparation practice, geography and sources. Language is not proof of origin. Cuisine labels are source assertions; regional variants are not erased by translation.
rules.diet: DietaryType is a shared concept. Suitability, allergen, certification and personal restriction assertions are separate, scoped, dated and evidence-bearing; source labels never become independently verified qualifications automatically.
rules.statistics: Every metric names its definition, unit, denominator, cohort, time, source method and qualifier. Nutrient, serving, whole-food, component, price and consumption statistics cannot be combined across incompatible bases.
rules.inventory: Product, ingredient concept, physical lot/batch, stock quantity, preparation, location and stock event are distinct. Bought, cooked, served, eaten, leftover and wasted quantities are separate facts. Private inventories, health and credentials are never promoted by canonical identity joins.
rules.translation: Any supported BCP47 locale can be attached to a resource field independent of source or country. Original text remains retrievable. Translation entries include source text hash, translator/method, status, terminology references and citations; stale or missing translations are explicit. Simple English publisher code maps to en-x-simple, retaining the original edition code.
rules.newTypes: Every new source must map fields and relations to this registry. New domains/units/types produce SchemaTypeProposal evidence before type registration; unrecognized fields become typed UnmappedSourceFact resources, never silently discarded or forced into a misleading existing type.
rules.rights: A common entity does not relicense its source assertions. Each citation carries licence, attribution, reuse scope and derivative requirements. Restricted source content stays in permitted local/private scope.

implementationOwner: OffMenu i18n task; this package defines data contracts, source alignment and collected artifacts only.

yield.description: Declared source recipe yield; unknown is retained.

requiredQuantity.basisDefault: Source recipe batch, never assumed per serving. Portion scaling requires the cited yield and source scaling rule.

optional.description: Optional ingredient flag, separate from amount and presence.

scalingRule.description: Source linear/damped/fixed scaling rule; no conversion to linear assumed.

instruction.description: Localized source preparation step text with stable text identity.

originalSourceRecord.description: Stable acquired record ID, separate from common resource ID.

sourceEditionLanguage.description: Publisher edition; not culinary origin or audience restriction.

sourceCulture.description: Original stated cultural context with source evidence.

sourceCuisineCountry.description: Original source country assertion; not a language inference.

sourceOriginalLanguages.description: Original book language codes, separate from adaptation language.

ingredientExtractionComplete.description: False for incomplete OCR ingredient extraction.

automaticPlanningEligible.description: Always false for unreviewed acquired recipes.

originalIngredientStatement.description: Original ingredient wording retained with citation; canonical quantities cite this as their normalization input.

sourceLanguages.description: All publisher-declared languages, independently of audience and country.

termAlias.description: Candidate lexical alias, never a substitute for identity/state/definition evidence.

originalRdfNotation.description: Original RDF attributes, datatype/language tags and lexical form remain fixed for audit.

sourcePropertyExtensions.rule: Typed source-specific fields preserve every additional source value. A reviewed crosswalk promotes the meaning to a shared property; unresolved fields do not disappear.
sourcePropertyExtensions.externalNamespaces: Original RDF/OWL predicate URIs are preserved as source-declared properties/relations. Source ontology statements are not exact matches to an OffMenu ingredient or dietary qualification.

fixedIdentifiers: formal expression syntax and original RDF lexical identifiers

referenceNamespaces.urn:offmenu:ingredient:: Shared ingredient concept registry; candidate aliases are not exact nutritional equivalence.
referenceNamespaces.urn:offmenu:country:: Country/source territory code registry; ISO assignments and source extension codes remain distinguished.
referenceNamespaces.urn:offmenu:unit:: Declared dimension/unit definitions; source notation is retained separately.
referenceNamespaces.urn:offmenu:recipe-concept:: Common recipe concept candidates with cited source variants; not a collapsed formulation.

actorRule: Organizations and people retain one identity. Producer, supplier, retailer and restaurant roles can coexist as cited hasRole assertions; a site is a separate resource.

valueTypes.expression: Fixed formal syntax (for example RDF/XML); not translated as natural-language display text. Human-facing labels/definitions are separate localized text values.
valueTypes.number: Typed numeric value; source lexical form, precision/fraction/range and method remain available where supplied.
valueTypes.identifier: A fixed namespace/code, never replaced by translated display labels.
valueTypes.uri: Fixed URI or internationalized resource identifier (IRI), including multilingual source URLs; preserve the original identifier rather than translating it.

normalizationEvidenceRule: Normalizer-derived quantities and default scaling are candidates/derivations, not independently verified source claims. Keep source statements and derivation input/method/review status.
